collection.description: A dead sea turtle washes ashore: a naturalist wants to learn, a child wants a burial.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A large turtle washes ashore already dead. A naturalist sees an opportunity to learn; a child wants a burial.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: Observations reveal signs of an old injury, and the remains are respectfully returned to the shore.

text_only.reason: the dead turtle's; no villager is hurt

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Children decorate a marker and discuss the animal's life.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: Craftspeople and researchers agree on limits; not everyone feels comfortable with the decision.
